When asked in the Green Room at the Warner-Grand Theater by producer Dan Pasley why he didn' t include the word "nigger" in that list, Carlin replied, "There' s nothing funny about it -- that really /s a dirty word -- but repressed words about sexual functions and bodily parts were truly funny. | had only been thinking about the 'dirty' words in terms of
